'''2012 Bespin Regionals Charlie Arlandson LS Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Charlie Arlandson]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers|Theed-L-naboobossnassschambers.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
